Judging mechanisms, not names: c2 (one oversized ellipse) and c3 (two rectangles meeting at the bodice-to-skirt seam) produce the same visible event - opaque bodice/hem blocks a flat field while the sheer ruffle tiers transmit and tint toward it - differing only in primitive count and shape, i.e. a palette/geometry rename of one figure-ground transparency idea. c1 (five landmark-locked horizontal bands) and c3 (one landmark-locked horizon) are the same device again: hard graphic edges registered onto garment seams behind the cutout, c3 merely using fewer edges. c4's offset original-alpha silhouette is the only genuinely different event (misregistered graphic double versus photographed material). Net: one transparency/edge-registration packshot idea stated three times plus one silhouette-echo idea.
